title: Department Objectives Toggle Cleanup
question:
Please restructure the "Department Objectives" area on my "Operating Plan Workspace" page so the objectives and their planning FAQ are easier to review.
**Task Requirements:** 1. In the "Department Objectives" section, create a new heading_3 block
   titled:

   "Customer Expansion"

2. Convert all four objective headings to toggles - the three existing
   objectives
   - "Product Quality"
   - "Revenue Operations"
   - "Customer Retention"
   - "Customer Expansion"

3. Move descriptions inside the toggles - every paragraph or list that
   originally sat directly under an objective heading should become a child
   block of that heading after it is made toggleable.

4. Replace the normal final clean-up sentence with a nested FAQ cleanup:
   inside the "Customer Expansion" toggle, add a "Planning FAQ" toggle with
   two columns. Move the first two existing Q&A pairs left, move the third
   Q&A pair right, and add one matching Q&A pair so both columns have
   exactly 2 Q&A pairs using heading_3 questions and paragraph answers.

5. Preserve content & order - apart from the changes above, do not modify
    the text, formatting, or order of existing objective descriptions.

The end result should be a clean "Department Objectives" section containing four toggleable objective headings, with a two-column Planning FAQ nested inside Customer Expansion.
